name: Pedestrian wind (OpenFOAM)
description: Adds OpenFOAM as an engine for the Environment wind study. OpenFOAM is GPL software that you install yourself; CadCraft never ships it. The add-on writes an OpenFOAM case from your masses for each wind direction, hands it to a small helper program on this computer (127.0.0.1 only) that runs OpenFOAM, and reads the pedestrian-height wind back. Off until you switch it on.
author: CadCraft
